name: algorithmic-prompting
description: Turn a software goal into parallel work, atomic commits, agent prompts, and clear integration handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a goal into parallel, commit-ready work.
interface.longDescription: Route work from intentionally structured repository layout, publish a minimal provisional index before implementation comprehension, then let concurrent subagents land thoroughly researched coding-agent prompts.
capabilities: Turn goals into executable work plans
Choose lean, balanced, or thorough prompt depth
Dispatch prompt details with concurrent subagents
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn this goal into a dependency-aware routing plan from repository instructions and intentionally structured layout only. Use lean prompts unless requested otherwise. Do not inspect implementation, tests, SDK, or UI before returning the provisional task index. Then dispatch concurrent prompt-detail subagents for thorough comprehension and return immediately after dispatch.
